knownResidue.what: Recent changes lists audit entries of clients that earlier automated tests and reviews added and deleted (named 'a deleted client (client 4)', 'client 13', 'client 14' and so on); the entry 'Client deleted for a deleted client (client 4)' is the deletion of the test client made for this capture
knownResidue.why kept: audit entries are kept by design after a client is deleted and cannot be removed without deleting the database, which is not a supported action on the shared Development installation; the entries name deleted clients by number only, so the pictures were captured again on 2026-10-22 once the test client with a ticket number in its name was gone. Nothing in the pictures was edited

knownResidue.what: the closed exception of the sample client carries the owner 'QA test owner THE-520' and a reason that names a ticket, labels left by an earlier test
knownResidue.why kept: the product offers no route to edit or delete an exception (an exception can only be added or closed; app/ui/clients.py), and deleting the sample client would remove the evidence, reports and exports every other guide shows. The picture of the first capture is kept and the labels are synthetic

A second capture with a newly saved neutral profile selected was planned in THE-703 but not made: the browser session was lost after the sixth capture and did not come back within the task, so this is an exact gap of that round
